reason: I'd grab the free tricks and play with them, but I'm not paying 99 ₪ by card on some website for an app that isn't in the App Store when I can't find a single real performance video or review or see who made it. I've bought magic stuff before and some of it was junk that looked great in the ad.
objection: No App Store, no reviews, no name behind it. If the search-reveal or the gallery video glitches in front of my friends, I'm the one who looks like an idiot, and I've got no idea if it actually holds up on my phone.
would_change_my_mind: Real unedited videos of people doing these tricks on regular phones, plus reviews from Israeli magicians or magic forums I recognise. If the free tricks also work perfectly on my phone a few times, I'd buy.
